changeSet.author: ved
changeSet.comment: equipment.department defaulted to 'active' (copy-paste from status). Department is always supplied, so no default.

changeSet.author: ved
changeSet.comment: The FK says ON DELETE SET NULL (general documents survive equipment deletion), which is impossible while the column is NOT NULL. Relaxing NOT NULL is release-safe.

changeSet.author: ved
changeSet.comment: uploaded_by was NOT NULL with the string default 'false' (meant for is_indexed). Make it a nullable name with no default; is_indexed gets the FALSE default it was meant to have.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE documents SET uploaded_by = NULL WHERE uploaded_by = 'false';

rollback.sql: UPDATE documents SET uploaded_by = 'false' WHERE uploaded_by IS NULL;

changeSet.author: ved
changeSet.comment: resolved_at was DATE while every other timestamp is TIMESTAMPTZ. DATE to TIMESTAMPTZ is a widening, lossless cast, and the column has never been written by the app, so the type change is safe here. (On a busy table you would add a new column, backfill and switch instead.)
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE issues ALTER COLUMN resolved_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING resolved_at::timestamptz;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE issues ALTER COLUMN resolved_at TYPE DATE USING resolved_at::date;

changeSet.author: ved
changeSet.comment: The v1.0 enum-casing fix wrote 'Water Treatment System' (three spaces). Normalise to the enum value the app validates.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE equipment SET equipment_type = 'Water Treatment System' WHERE equipment_type = 'Water Treatment System';

changeSet.author: ved
changeSet.comment: A negative reorder threshold makes no sense; enforce it in the database as well as the API.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE parts ADD CONSTRAINT reorder_threshold_check CHECK (reorder_threshold >= 0);

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE parts DROP CONSTRAINT reorder_threshold_check;
